annotations.text:
Settled: the hero carries the projection beam in both themes, and the record is saved for the closing section.

Dark hero uses the same beam construction as the light page, so the two themes are one idea lit differently.

Dark close is the grooved horizon — the record rises from the bottom edge and the label breaks the fold, so the dome and the wordmark land as the last image on the page.

B and C are kept for reference. C's beam is what the light page now uses.

Twelve findings read from the built page.

Four break outright on a 1:1 token port, five need care, three are plumbing that does not exist yet.

The action green is the one thing that needs no work at all.
